items.open_question: The tablet strength reads 250 mg or 500 mg. Which did the doctor mean?
items.plain_summary_en: Azithromycin is an antibiotic, taken once a day for three days. I want to be careful with this one, because the strength on the note was not clear, so our pharmacist will confirm it with you.
items.plain_summary_ar: الأزيثرومايسين مضاد حيوي يؤخذ مرة يومياً لمدة ثلاثة أيام. سأكون حذراً لأن التركيز المكتوب لم يكن واضحاً، وسيؤكده لك الصيدلي.

items.timing: every 6 hours, only when you have a fever or pain
items.plain_summary_en: Paracetamol brings down a fever and eases aches and pains. Take one tablet every six hours, only when you need it.
items.plain_summary_ar: الباراسيتامول يخفض الحرارة ويخفف الآلام. تناول قرصاً واحداً كل ست ساعات، فقط عند الحاجة.
items.warnings: Do not take any other medicine that contains paracetamol with it.
